title: UK Recruiter
description:
Recruitment Consultant – UK RPO/ UK Recruiter

Experience: 1–2 years

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only

Job Timing: 12:30 PM to 10 PM (UK shift)

2 Rounds of Interview (Virtual and Walk-In)

About the Role:

We are looking for a motivated and target-driven Recruitment Consultant to join our UK focused RPO delivery team in India.

The Recruitment Consultant will work as an extension of our UK clients’ internal recruitment

teams, managing candidate sourcing, screening, engagement and recruitment coordination

across multiple vacancies.

The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing skills, excellent communication, attention to

detail and the ability to work against recruitment KPIs and client SLAs.

Key Responsibilities:

\* Manage end-to-end recruitment delivery for assigned UK vacancies.

\* Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, CV databases, referrals and direct sourcing.

\* Review CVs and shortlist candidates against job specifications.

\* Conduct initial candidate screening and competency-based interviews.

\* Contact candidates and explain job opportunities, requirements and processes.

\* Maintain an active and qualified candidate pipeline.

\* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.

\* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

\* Manage candidate offers, on boarding and pre-employment processes where applicable.

\* Maintain accurate candidate information within the ATS/CRM.

\* Ensure recruitment activity meets agreed client SLAs and KPIs.

\* Provide regular recruitment updates and reports to the team/client.

\* Build strong candidate relationships and improve candidate experience.

\* Work closely with Account Managers, Recruitment Leads and UK stakeholders.

\* Maintain confidentiality and follow UK recruitment and data-protection requirements.

Required Skills & Experience:

\* 1–4 years of recruitment experience.

\* Experience in UK recruitment or international recruitment preferred.

\* Strong knowledge of sourcing and candidate screening.

\* Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter / LinkedIn, Indeed, Reed, Total jobs or similar platforms.

\* Strong written and verbal English communication.

\* Good understanding of recruitment processes and candidate lifecycle.

\* Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.

\* Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills.

\* Comfortable working with targets, KPIs and deadlines.

\* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and ATS/CRM systems.

Preferred Experience:

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

\* UK Healthcare Recruitment

\* NHS Recruitment

\* Social Care Recruitment

\* Nursing & Medical Recruitment

\* IT Recruitment

\* Engineering Recruitment

\* Professional Services Recruitment

\* Volume Recruitment

\* RPO / MSP recruitment

\* Contract / Temporary Staffing

Key KPIs:

\* Qualified candidates sourced

\* CV submissions

\* Interviews arranged

\* Interview-to-offer conversion

\* Offer-to-joiner conversion

\* Placements / hires

\* Time to fill

\* Candidate response rate

\* Client SLA achievement

\* Recruitment pipeline activity

What We Offer:

\* Exposure to the UK recruitment market

\* Opportunity to work directly with international clients

\* Structured RPO recruitment environment

\* Training and development

\* Performance-based incentives

\* Career progression into Senior Recruiter / Team Leader / Recruitment Manager Roles

\* Collaborative and growth-focused working environment

Ideal Candidate:

We are looking for someone who is proactive, commercially aware and highly organised, with

the ability to source quality candidates quickly and manage the recruitment process from initial

contact through to placement.

Candidates who have worked in UK recruitment, RPO, volume recruitment or international

staffing will be particularly suitable.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹42,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: US healthcare Recruiter (Medical billing)
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented US Recruiter to manage end-to-end recruitment activities for the US Medical Billing industry. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, knowledge of recruitment processes, and the ability to source, screen, and hire suitable candidates within defined timelines.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for US Medical Billing positions.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic interviews.
* Understand job requirements and coordinate with hiring managers.
* Schedule interviews and follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Maintain candidate databases and update recruitment trackers.
* Negotiate salaries and coordinate offer rollouts and joining formalities.
* Achieve recruitment targets and meet hiring deadlines.
* Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future requirements.

Required Skills

* Good verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Knowledge of recruitment processes and candidate sourcing techniques.
* Familiarity with job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, and Indeed.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work in a target-driven environment.
* Knowledge of US healthcare or Medical Billing recruitment will be an added advantage.

Core Responsibilities

* End-to-End Recruitment: Own the full hiring cycle from identifying workforce needs to onboarding candidates.
* Role Alignment: Coordinate with hiring managers to define exact technical requirements for specialized US RCM positions (such as AR Analysts, AR Callers, **Medical Billers, Payment Posters, Medical Coders,** and QAi Auditors).
* Multi-Channel Sourcing: Source candidates via job boards like Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, professional networks, employee referrals, and walk-in drives.
* Screening & Assessment: Conduct initial phone screens to evaluate English communication skills, night-shift or rotational flexibility, and domain understanding (e.g., US insurance workflows, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers).
* Interview Coordination: Schedule and coordinate technical assessments (such as AR calculations, billing knowledge, or Excel tests) and panel interviews with operations leaders.
* Offer Management: Handle salary negotiations within approved budget bands, roll out offer letters, and track key metrics like time-to-fill and offer-to-join ratios.

Educational Qualification

* Any Graduate; HR or Management qualification preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with prior experience in US recruitment, US healthcare recruitment, or Medical Billing recruitment will be preferred.
* Freshers with excellent English communication skills and a willingness to work in recruitment may also apply.

**Note:** Willingness to work in US time zones or rotational shifts may be required, depending on business requirements.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition professional with a strong background in the manufacturing industry to manage end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition activities. The ideal candidate should have experience hiring for manufacturing, engineering, plant operations, corporate functions, and leadership positions.

The role will primarily focus on recruitment (70%), with the remaining 30% dedicated to strategic talent acquisition, workforce planning, employer branding, recruitment analytics, and process improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment – 70%**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, salary negotiation, offer management, and onboarding.
* Handle hiring for manufacturing, engineering, production, quality, maintenance, design, supply chain, finance, HR, and corporate functions.
* Manage recruitment for shop-floor, plant-level, middle-management, senior-management, and leadership positions.
* Use job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, recruitment consultants, and professional networks to identify suitable candidates.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and department heads to understand manpower requirements and ensure timely closure of vacancies.
* Maintain talent pipelines for critical and recurring positions.
* Track recruitment metrics, including time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, offer acceptance, joining ratios, and sourcing effectiveness.

**2. Talent Acquisition & Strategic Activities – 30%**

* Develop and implement talent acquisition strategies aligned with business requirements.
* Coordinate manpower planning and workforce forecasting with department heads.
* Strengthen employer branding and enhance the company's visibility in the talent market.
* Build talent pipelines for niche, critical, and leadership positions.
* Monitor industry hiring trends, salary benchmarks, and talent availability.
* Prepare recruitment dashboards, MIS reports, and hiring performance analyses.
* Improve recruitment processes and candidate experience.
* Develop relationships with recruitment consultants, technical institutes, and engineering colleges.
* Support campus hiring, employee referral programs, and continuous recruitment process improvement.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 9-10 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably in the manufacturing or engineering industry.
* Strong expertise in end-to-end recruitment for technical, engineering, plant, and corporate roles.
* Good understanding of manufacturing operations and industrial manpower requirements.
* Experience in stakeholder management, salary negotiation, manpower planning, and recruitment analytics.
* Proficiency in job portals, LinkedIn Recruiter, MS Excel, and recruitment MIS.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, coordination, and team-management skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely closure of approved vacancies.
* Quality of hire and hiring manager satisfaction.
* Offer acceptance and candidate joining ratios.
* Recruitment cost optimization and sourcing effectiveness.
* Timely and accurate recruitment MIS reporting.
* Development of talent pipelines for critical positions.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

description:
SUMMARY

We are looking for a **Social Media Recruiter with strong expertise in sourcing from LinkedIn & other social networks for US IT recruitment**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, engaging, screening, and building talent pipelines for US-based IT requirements, with **primary focus on LinkedIn Recruiter/social media sourcing** and additional sourcing through **Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, and other job portals**.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Source qualified IT professionals primarily through **LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn networking, Boolean search, and social media platforms**.
* Utilize **Dice, and other job portals** to supplement candidate sourcing and pipeline development.
* Handle end-to-end recruitment activities including **sourcing, candidate engagement, screening, submission, interview coordination, follow-up, negotiation, and closure**.
* Understand technical requirements and identify candidates across technologies such as **Java, .NET, Data Engineering, Cloud, DevOps, QA, AI/ML, Salesforce, and other IT skill sets**.
* Screen candidates based on **technical skills, experience, location, availability, work authorization, and compensation expectations**.
* Maintain strong candidate relationships and continuously develop talent pipelines for current and future requirements.
* Work with **W2, C2C, 1099, and Full-Time** hiring models and understand basic US staffing/tax terminology.

* Maintain accurate candidate information, submissions, follow-ups, and recruitment activity in the **ATS/CRM**.
* Meet daily/weekly sourcing, submission, interview, and placement targets.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

**Required Skills:**

* 2–5+ years of **US IT Recruitment / US Staffing** experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with **LinkedIn Recruiter and social media sourcing**.
* Experience with **Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder**, and other recruitment portals.
* Strong **Boolean search, candidate engagement, and passive candidate sourcing** skills.
* Good understanding of **US IT staffing, tax terms (W2/C2C/1099), and visa/work authorization**.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, follow-up, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to work independently in a **US shift environment** and handle multiple requirements simultaneously.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience recruiting for **direct clients, implementation partners, and staffing vendors**.
* Experience with **JobDiva, Bullhorn, Ceipal, or other ATS/CRM platforms**.
* Proven ability to generate candidates primarily through **LinkedIn rather than relying solely on job portals**.
* Strong understanding of US IT technologies and the staffing market.
